category: Data Protection Policies, Processes, and Procedures (PR.PO-P)
subcategory_text: Response plans (Incident Response and Business Continuity) and recovery plans (Incident Recovery and Disaster Recovery) are established, in place, and managed.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: CP-2 (Contingency Plan), IR-8 (Incident Response Plan)
ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.5.24 (Information security incident management planning), A.5.29 (Information security during disruption)
GDPR Art. 32(1)(b) (Security of processing — Resilience), Art. 33 (Breach notification timing)
implementation_examples: Establish and maintain response plans (incident response, business continuity) and recovery plans (incident recovery, disaster recovery) covering privacy-relevant scenarios (data loss, breach, unauthorised disclosure)
Assign roles, define triggers, capture critical assets, and document decision criteria
Maintain plan currency with respect to changes in data, systems, or regulation
assessment_objectives: Determine whether response and recovery plans exist and cover privacy scenarios
Determine whether the plans define roles, triggers, and decision criteria
Determine whether the plans are reviewed and refreshed on change
Determine whether the plans are accessible to responders
